scope: Synthetic locomotion: 11 stock unit types, normal radii/speeds, all weapon damage disabled, no AI, no paid production. Timings exclude instrumentation and rendering. Not a native FPS/input-latency certification.
acceptance: Every unit within 1 world unit of its distinct assigned goal simultaneously by 240 simulated seconds; no obstacle penetration or speed-limit violation; every command replaces its queue. Open/turn cases: every unit makes progress toward its new goal within 2 seconds. Closed barrier: no crossing before release at 10 seconds. Failures retained.
